# Mingzy — Free Random Video & Text Chat Platform

> Mingzy is a free random video chat platform that lets people connect with strangers through instant browser-based video conversations without requiring mandatory account creation.

## Core Features & Capabilities

- **Zero-Friction Anonymous Chat**: Instant 1-click video or text matchmaking without mandatory sign-up.
- **WebRTC Peer-to-Peer Encryption**: Direct browser-to-browser media relay using standard DTLS-SRTP encryption; video feeds are never recorded or stored on central servers.
- **Smart Language & Region Routing**: Algorithmic pairing queue supporting language filtering (English, Hindi, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, etc.) and regional routing.
- **Instant Skip & Next**: Seamless 1-tap skip capability to immediately transition to the next available conversation partner.
- **Trust & Safety Controls**: Real-time 1-click reporting, immediate peer blocking, and zero-tolerance moderation standards.
- **Universal Browser Compatibility**: High-performance responsive web client (desktop/mobile browsers) operating via native WebRTC without app downloads.
